question: What percentage of the urban population in India lives in slum conditions as per the Census 2011?
solution:
The Correct answer is __17.4%__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As per the **Census 2011**, **17.4%** of the **urban population** in India lives in **slum conditions**.
 
• A slum is characterized by **poor housing conditions, lack of sanitation, and overcrowding.**
